title: SQL Server Connection Error
author: kaansengul
body_snippet:
First I wrote server name, login and password (for SQL Server Auth), then it gave me this error:

```
---------------------------
Error (5/25/2026 11:48:06 PM)
---------------------------
VerifyDatabaseVersion (Config.Connections.Save) failed. Cannot find the object "tblExternalTools" because it does not exist or you do not have permissions.
---------------------------
OK   
---------------------------
```

Then I wrote Database name in field "Database" as "mRemoteNG", then it gave me this error...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the detailed report — both errors are already understood and being fixed under #113.

- **First error** (`Cannot find the object "tblExternalTools"`): this happens when the **Database** field is left empty, so mRemoteNG connects to the server's default database instead of the one holding your tables. Filling in the database name (as you did) is the right move.
- **Second error** (`Incorrect syntax near 'DEFAULT'` … near a backtick): a genuine bug in the schema-upgrade steps that run w...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks, that detail cracked it — "unchecked but it still reconnects last sessions" pointed straight at a real bug. 🎯

There were **two** separate "reopen last session" mechanisms, and only one of them honored your **Reconnect on startup** checkbox. The other — the one that restores your saved window layout — was reopening every connection tab that was open when you last closed mRemoteNG, *regardless* of that setting.
